items.name: 极霜
items.intro: 冰晶凝住锋芒，极光掠过桌沿。
items.theme: Theme: POLAR FROST / 极霜. Obsidian midnight-blue glass beneath exquisite sharp translucent ice crystals at the frame corners. Frosted silver filigree, cold cyan reflections, subtle aurora-green ribbons tracing the very bottom rim, a small sculpted ice spire cluster at far-right midpoint. Glacial elegant magical power. Dark calm interior with restrained fog only near edges. Not blue fire, not a starry galaxy. Physically beautiful faceted clear ice, no crown or emblems.

items.name: 幽海
items.intro: 潜入无声深海，让幽光替你发声。
items.theme: Theme: BIOLUMINESCENT ABYSS / 幽海. Blackened ocean-teal interior, exquisite iridescent abalone and dark silver frame with fluid wave-like curves. Bioluminescent turquoise sea tendrils, tiny aqua and electric-blue coral tips cling to the lower rim and corners, a small ethereal translucent jellyfish-like sea-light detail hugs the right edge midpoint. Deep underwater magic, hypnotic organic fluidity, dark velvet water in the center. Avoid whole underwater landscapes, fish swimming through text areas, literal bubbles behind text.

items.name: 龙珀
items.intro: 青玉藏龙，云纹之间自有威仪。
items.theme: Theme: EASTERN JADE DRAGON / 龙珀. Deep black ink-green lacquer center, luxurious carved translucent celadon jade frame with antique warm bronze-gold fine seams. Stylized Eastern cloud scrolls and a sinuous carved jade dragon relief integrated along the bottom and right edge; dragon's small elegant head remains at far-right midpoint, never projecting into center. Subtle amber glows inside jade, pale mint-green material glints. Sophisticated Chinese decorative artistry, distinct from European gold filigree. No writing, seal stamps, red calligraphy, coins, pagoda or big animal filling center.

items.name: 绯樱
items.intro: 一席夜樱，把锋芒藏进温柔。
items.theme: Theme: NIGHT SAKURA / 绯樱. Very dark plum-black and rosewood lacquer interior. Refined thin rose-gold curved frame entwined with delicate dark cherry branches, pale pink sakura blossoms concentrated at top-left outer corner and bottom-right edge; a crescent-shaped flowing ribbon of luminous pink petals hugs the far-right rim. Tiny petal glints confined to perimeter. Romantic yet powerful fantasy cosmetic, elegant soft pink accents rather than a neon border. Small blooms and sculptural rose-gold finish. Keep all branches and petals out of interior text zones; no centered flower bouquet, moon, characters or text.

items.name: 时轮
items.intro: 黄铜齿轮转动，掌握自己的节奏。
items.theme: Theme: ARCANE CLOCKWORK / 时轮. Dark espresso-black worn leather and black iron center, intricate brushed brass and bronze frame. Exposed tiny interlocking mechanical gears and concentric engraved metal arcs built into the corners and lower edge, a beautiful compact turquoise aether energy mechanism at the far-right mid-edge. Victorian steampunk sophistication, warm copper reflections, subtle teal electricity contained at the rim. Bold material character, precision craftsmanship. No clock dial, numbers, readable markings, gauge-like buttons, oversized gears obscuring center or industrial scene.

items.name: 蚀日
items.intro: 日冕划破暗夜，沉默亦有引力。
items.theme: Theme: TOTAL SOLAR ECLIPSE / 蚀日. Ultra-deep violet-black obsidian interior with a clean expansive dark center. Smoked black chrome frame and thin champagne-white molten-light trims. On far-right mid-edge a small mysterious black eclipse disc with a sharp luminous pale gold corona; radial wisps arc vertically along the right rim, slender gravitational light ribbons run along lower edge. Ominous cosmic nobility, dramatic bright silver-white solar rim against total black, no full card of stars or fire. Warm-white solar plasma rather than red/orange lava, no big planet in center, no central circular UI icon.

items.name: 幻晶
items.intro: 万色折光，让每次亮相都不同。
items.theme: Theme: IRIDESCENT PRISM / 幻晶. Dark aubergine-black glass center. Exquisitely cut faceted opal and transparent crystal frame with subtle holographic mother-of-pearl reflections shifting mint, lilac, blush pink and pale champagne. Geometric crystal shards fitted closely along the rim and in asymmetric corner clusters, a small prismatic crystal fan at the right midpoint. Luxurious modern fantasy, polished gemstone artistry, spectral refracted edge highlights. Bright pearlescent perimeter with dark calm interior, not a neon cyberpunk circuit, no gem floating in center or rainbow stripes across the text area.
